name: stringops2.k
model:
class StringOps2 {
  text:String

  req text = "hello world hello"
  idx1:Int

  req idx1 = text.indexOf("world")

  req idx1 = 6
  idx2:Int

  req idx2 = text.indexOf("hello")

  req idx2 = 0
  idx3:Int

  req idx3 = text.indexOf("xyz")

  req idx3 = -1
  replaced:String

  req replaced = text.replace("hello","hi")

  req replaced = "hi world hello"
}

main:StringOps2
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((StringOps2 (mk-StringOps2 (text String)(idx1 Int)(idx2 Int)(idx3 Int)(replaced String)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-StringOps2 (sel-StringOps2 StringOps2))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-StringOps2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-StringOps2 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-StringOps2 ((this Ref)) StringOps2
  (sel-StringOps2 (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-StringOps2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-StringOps2 this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.main: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!main ((this Ref)) Ref
  (main (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ---------------------------------
;   Getters for class StringOps2:
; ---------------------------------

; --- getters for StringOps2.text: ---

(define-fun StringOps2!text ((this Ref)) String
  (text (deref-StringOps2 this))
)

; --- getters for StringOps2.idx1: ---

(define-fun StringOps2!idx1 ((this Ref)) Int
  (idx1 (deref-StringOps2 this))
)

; --- getters for StringOps2.idx2: ---

(define-fun StringOps2!idx2 ((this Ref)) Int
  (idx2 (deref-StringOps2 this))
)

; --- getters for StringOps2.idx3: ---

(define-fun StringOps2!idx3 ((this Ref)) Int
  (idx3 (deref-StringOps2 this))
)

; --- getters for StringOps2.replaced: ---

(define-fun StringOps2!replaced ((this Ref)) String
  (replaced (deref-StringOps2 this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-StringOps2 (TopLevelDeclarations!main this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; -----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class StringOps2:
; -----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-StringOps2 StringOps2)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun StringOps2.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringOps2!text this) "hello world hello")
)

(assert (! (StringOps2.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun StringOps2.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringOps2!idx1 this) (str.indexof (StringOps2!text this) "world" 0))
)

(assert (! (StringOps2.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun StringOps2.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringOps2!idx1 this) 6)
)

(assert (! (StringOps2.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun StringOps2.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringOps2!idx2 this) (str.indexof (StringOps2!text this) "hello" 0))
)

(assert (! (StringOps2.inv4 1) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun StringOps2.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringOps2!idx2 this) 0)
)

(assert (! (StringOps2.inv5 1) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun StringOps2.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringOps2!idx3 this) (str.indexof (StringOps2!text this) "xyz" 0))
)

(assert (! (StringOps2.inv6 1) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Invariant 7: ---

(define-fun StringOps2.inv7 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringOps2!idx3 this) (- 1))
)

(assert (! (StringOps2.inv7 1) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 8: ---

(define-fun StringOps2.inv8 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringOps2!replaced this) (str.replace (StringOps2!text this) "hello" "hi"))
)

(assert (! (StringOps2.inv8 1) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Invariant 9: ---

(define-fun StringOps2.inv9 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringOps2!replaced this) "hi world hello")
)

(assert (! (StringOps2.inv9 1) :named _xkassert9))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-StringOps2 const-1-StringOps2))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-StringOps2 () StringOps2
  (mk-StringOps2 "hello world hello" 6 0 (- 1) "hi world hello"))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (= (idx3 (sel-StringOps2 (select heap 1))) (- 1)))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (str.indexof (text (sel-StringOps2 (select heap 1))) "world" 0)))
  (= (idx1 (sel-StringOps2 (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (= (idx2 (sel-StringOps2 (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (= (replaced (sel-StringOps2 (select heap 1))) "hi world hello"))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (main (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-StringOps2 a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (str.replace (text (sel-StringOps2 (select heap 1))) "hello" "hi")))
  (= (replaced (sel-StringOps2 (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (= (idx1 (sel-StringOps2 (select heap 1))) 6))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (str.indexof (text (sel-StringOps2 (select heap 1))) "xyz" 0)))
  (= (idx3 (sel-StringOps2 (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (= (text (sel-StringOps2 (select heap 1))) "hello world hello"))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (str.indexof (text (sel-StringOps2 (select heap 1))) "hello" 0)))
  (= (idx2 (sel-StringOps2 (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-StringOps2 (mk-StringOps2 "hello world hello"
                                       6
                                       0
                                       (- 1)
                                       "hi world hello"))))
